# Assessment

Choose migrate-inference before the service deadline. Schedule rollout and verification ahead of the brownouts; active usage is no exemption.

GitHub Models retires fully on July 30, 2026, including inference API and BYOK endpoints.

Retirement includes existing customers with active usage.

Scheduled brownouts occur on July 16 and July 23, 2026.
